_what: One pack per rendering register. A pack supplies the slots that describe HOW a frame is rendered, never WHAT is in it — so the same subject can be shot as candid UGC or drawn as flat vector by swapping one word. Read off the registers our own briefs actually used (2026-09-14): five, from six briefs — eight packs today. The element library reads this file as its style/image list.

candid-ugc.name: Candid UGC
candid-ugc.what: A photograph a real person would have taken of themselves or a friend. The register most swipes are in.
candid-ugc.shot: close, at the subject's own height, level, straight on, shallow depth so the background falls away
candid-ugc.light: soft frontal light with a slight top-down bias, raking enough to show surface texture rather than flatter it
candid-ugc.grade: natural grade, true colour, blacks lifted slightly
candid-ugc.style: candid, unstyled, native to a phone camera roll
candid-ugc.texture: unretouched and no better than the source — visible pores, follicles, marks and micro-shadows, slight softness, the compression and noise of a phone photo, nothing smoothed and nothing upgraded
candid-ugc.negatives: no studio lighting, no professional retouching, no camera, no phone, no tripod, no lighting equipment in frame, no watermark, no text unless the brief puts it on a surface in the world, not sharper or cleaner than the phone that took it

mirror-selfie.name: Mirror selfie
mirror-selfie.what: Shot through a mirror, phone visible in the subject's hands. The only register where a phone belongs in frame, because the mirror explains it.
mirror-selfie.shot: medium close, chest height, level, seen through a wall-mounted mirror, moderate depth with the subject sharp
mirror-selfie.light: hard natural daylight from one side with deep shadow opposite, mixed with ambient room fill
mirror-selfie.grade: natural grade, crushed blacks in the deep shadows
mirror-selfie.style: native phone mirror selfie, unstyled domestic interior
mirror-selfie.texture: unretouched — real skin with visible pores and natural imperfections
mirror-selfie.negatives: no ring light, no professional lighting, no tripod, no jewellery, no watch, no logos, no watermark, no digital overlays

studio-object.name: Studio object
studio-object.what: The product alone on a controlled ground. Everything that reads as the ad is composited afterwards.
studio-object.shot: straight on, level, at the height of the object, centre-weighted, deep focus edge to edge
studio-object.light: soft overhead fill building a smooth gradient, one hard rim light entering from the side
studio-object.style: clean digital studio render, no film grain, no texture on the ground beyond its own sheen
studio-object.texture: true material finish — matte where matte, reflective where reflective
studio-object.negatives: no text, no typography, no watermark, no figures, no hands, no shadows of objects that are not there, no colour outside the stated palette

flat-vector.name: Flat vector
flat-vector.what: Drawn, not photographed. Meme and comic register — the swipe file uses it to make a problem safe to look at.
flat-vector.shot: straight on, level, chest height, subject centred and cut at the upper thigh, everything equally crisp
flat-vector.light: flat, soft and uniform, no modelling
flat-vector.grade: solid colour fills on a flat ground
flat-vector.style: flat vector illustration, thick black outlines, solid fills, no gradients, meme and comic aesthetic
flat-vector.texture: none — clean digital, no shading, no realistic rendering
flat-vector.negatives: no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering, no watermark

diagnostic-scan.name: Diagnostic scan
diagnostic-scan.what: A glowing translucent body against a void. Reframes a cosmetic problem as a medical reading.
diagnostic-scan.shot: profile or three-quarter, at eye height, level, cropped at the chest, deep focus
diagnostic-scan.light: strong warm rim light from behind and to one side, soft fill from the front
diagnostic-scan.grade: high contrast, crushed blacks, gradient void from charcoal at centre to near-black at the edges
diagnostic-scan.style: clean digital 3D medical infographic, glowing and semi-translucent
diagnostic-scan.texture: pathology reads as denser, more opaque interruptions in the glow
diagnostic-scan.negatives: no full body, no nudity, no bare chest, no text, no UI, no labels, no callout boxes, no room, no floor, no furniture, no photograph, no face meeting camera

selfie.name: Selfie
selfie.what: She is holding the camera. The phone IS the camera, so it is never in frame — a phone visible in a selfie means the picture is OF someone taking a selfie, which is a different photograph (Damon, 2026-09-14).
selfie.shot: arm's length, at her own eye height or slightly above, one arm out of frame toward the lens, close, deep enough focus that the room behind reads
selfie.light: whatever light the room has — a window, a lamp, mixed and uncorrected
selfie.style: a photograph she took of herself on her own phone and posted the same day
selfie.texture: unretouched and no better than the source — pores, flyaways, uneven skin, phone-camera softness and noise, nothing smoothed, nothing upgraded
selfie.negatives: NO PHONE IN FRAME, no camera, no hand holding a device, no mirror unless the brief asks for one, no studio lighting, no ring light, no tripod, no retouching, no shallow cinematic depth of field, no professional portrait lighting, not sharper or cleaner than the phone that took it

studio-portrait-bw.name: Studio portrait, black and white
studio-portrait-bw.what: A deliberate editorial portrait against a void. The one register here that is allowed to look made.
studio-portrait-bw.shot: close, eye height, level, portrait-compressed, moderate depth
studio-portrait-bw.light: soft directional loop light from one side, falling off into black
studio-portrait-bw.grade: black and white, crushed blacks, high contrast on the eyes
studio-portrait-bw.style: editorial portrait against a dark flat void, no environment
studio-portrait-bw.texture: every pore, line and hair kept — the point of the register is age, undisguised
studio-portrait-bw.negatives: no colour, no sepia, no retouching, no smoothing, no glamour filter, no environment, no furniture, no window, no props, no text, no product

vintage-print.name: Scanned vintage print
vintage-print.what: Reads as a physical photograph that was kept, held and scanned — not a filter.
vintage-print.shot: mid-shot, chest height, level, moderate depth
vintage-print.light: frontal, soft, like a bounced on-camera flash
vintage-print.grade: warm sepia or monochrome, lifted blacks
vintage-print.style: a scanned physical film print — heavy grain throughout, creases across the image, yellowed borders, surface glare in one corner
vintage-print.texture: the damage is real: grain, folds, the gloss of a print under light
vintage-print.negatives: no digital cleanliness, no sharpness, no modern clothing or objects, no text, no watermark, no product

_result_budget._what: How much better a result is ALLOWED to look. Orthogonal to the packs: a pack says how a frame is rendered, this says what a frame may claim. Set "result": true on any slot file whose frame shows an after state, a treated area or a before/after — the anchors and bans below are appended to that ad's own, and judge.py checks the same list off the picture that comes back.
_result_budget._why: Ruled 2026-09-14, from the AvatarHype extraction. Our texture slot already held skin truth; nothing held the CLAIM. A plate that cleared the skin completely passed every test we ran — which is a believable machine shipping an unbelievable ad. Their numbers, adopted as-is: a total fix reads as fake, so the fix is never total.
_result_budget.anchors: the improvement is partial and incomplete, roughly 60-70% better and never fully cleared; three to five marks from the original condition survive and stay legible; freckles, moles, scars and skin texture are preserved exactly as they were; the same person under the same light as the before frame; healed skin still reads as skin, with pores and micro-shadow
_result_budget.negatives: no fully cleared or flawless result, no glow, no halo, no bloom, no airbrushed or plastic skin, no softer lens or warmer grade than the before frame, no evenly spaced or symmetrical marks, no different face, no beauty retouching of any kind
budget: The improvement is PARTIAL — roughly 60-70% better, never cleared.
Some of the original condition survives: 3-5 residual marks, still visible, not blurred out.
Freckles, moles, scars and skin texture are still there. Pores read.
It is the SAME person in the same light as the before — not a different face, not a different grade, not a softer lens.
No glow, no halo, no bloom, no plastic or airbrushed skin.
Nothing is symmetrical or evenly spaced that would not be in life.
